holdout_policy: Select deterministic hash order, max one question per answerability class per exact normalized context. Exclude exact and near duplicates against all previous complexity rows using original thresholds; exclude near question duplicates within holdout. Abort if fewer than 16 per class/title. Selection is independent of model predictions.
train_policy: Gold24 is the unchanged balanced pilot. Gold242 is ALL frozen original TRAIN rows, first gold answer or NO_ANSWER; no external/dev/test training. Same hyperparameters and 242 optimizer steps, not same epochs or target tokens. Each full-train row once, pilot repeats 10 or 11 times.
evaluation: First 6 train and full dev runs. Freeze dev-only decision and adapters before any new holdout inference. Then evaluate original student and all 6 candidates once each on new 64-row cross-article holdout, even failed candidates. No old-test inference. No tuning or seed selection after holdout.
limits: 2 additional articles from same public SQuAD dev release, not official hidden test nor new dataset or pretraining-clean. Balanced 64-row sample not natural prevalence. 3 seeds descriptive, no significance claim.
budget: Local cached student only, no paid API, no downloads or publication. Stop after these fixed runs; preserve failures.
